batch_semantics: One immutable plan for the batch. Registered coordinate or finite ask/tell scheduling uses the same receipt executor; plan submission executes nothing.

policy.computation: Reported separately; never substitutes for reach or holding acceptance.
policy.objective: Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked.
policy.rule: Joint acceptance first; otherwise componentwise physical comparison.
policy.tradeoff: Any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement.

coverage.definition: Both endpoints, timestamps aligned to task sample_period_s; missing samples are unavailable, never a pass.

duration.definition: Final closed interval [task duration - window, task duration].

position.definition: Maximum sampled world tip position error in the final interval.

speed.definition: Maximum sampled world tip translational speed norm in the final interval.
Euclidean norm of tip-site translational Jacobian times recorded backend qvel, reconstructed with sealed robot.xml and qpos; no finite differencing

terminal.definition: Euclidean world tip position error at the final execution sample; sealed evaluate.reach is the outcome authority.

control_period.definition: Simulated control spacing; synchronous wall overruns do not imply skipped applied updates or injected actuator delay.

duration.definition: Simulated task horizon, separate from computation wall time.

timing.interpretation: Applied updates, initialization selections, simulated duration and measured wall time are separate facts.

control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight.description: Dimensionless terminal weight on squared world tip speed / tip_speed_scale_m_s. Zero preserves legacy cost.

fidelity_limits: Exactly one point is tested (terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.10, holding 0.0) on one frozen stack; whatever it records describes that tested candidate only and establishes neither a continuous range nor effectiveness/ineffectiveness across the weight domain.

A single complete closed-loop backend run plus comparison against the retained baseline and the 0/0.05 predecessor is not a counterfactual replay; no weight or mechanism can be identified as the dominant cause of the reach/holding outcome.

Sampled holding evidence covers only the final 0.05 s (6 samples) with continuous_time_guarantee false; wall deadline misses and simulated steps stay separate, and an overrun does not imply skipped applied updates or injected actuator delay.
One-step position predictions do not certify holding-window tip speed, and world tip frames, projected GVS state and serial backend joint coordinates remain distinct.

The five supplied completed records (0/0, 0.05/0.0, holding-only 0.10, holding-only 0.30, 0/0.05) remain references from their own candidates and cannot be rebound to the new effective configuration; the planned 0.10 terminal / 0.0 holding configuration has no prior run.
plan.hypothesis: Route A, one point: on the frozen stack with control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight fixed at 0.0, a fresh complete backend run at control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight = 0.10 (immediate predecessor 0.05, execution 50618bf2) is predicted to move the sampled final-window holding maximum world-tip speed further toward the task criterion (speed_limit_m_s 0.02, position_limit_m 0.01, window 0.05 s) while terminal reach is retained (terminal_error_m <= 0.01 m, terminal_reach_passed true). The record will either show a further reduction of sampled hold speed with reach retained, or show reach loss / no further reduction; a single tested point does not by itself identify a dominant cause of the reach/holding outcome.
plan.rationale: Immutable plan linked to predecessor_decision f7b6f5945761dff9ee45e97a6f8927bd3160ea6f3a391889df63f1bda05109cb and predecessor_plan 43a6daab7e3c1ce6db033408eea6e087a95e3cd2f3acf86f1b66205c4554e128. Follows the accepted model decision: Route A (F548 route continue_weight_combinations), only control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight varies, control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight fixed at 0.0 (F489); retained baseline 0/0 (cf997605...), immediate predecessor 0/0.05 (50618bf2..., recorded terminal weight 0.05, F1684). Intended new complete results: exactly ONE changed configuration (terminal 0.10), declared before launch: the accepted bounded check names a single point (F516 'stop after the single 0.10 point'), the predecessor's decision intends one new complete result, 0.10 is the smallest increment beyond the completed 0.05 point and no step size for a larger move is evidenced, so a second point would be an unevidenced sweep; one point preserves the 2-backend grant and the >=600 s interpretation reserve. The configuration terminal 0.10 with holding 0.0 has not been executed (the supplied records are 0/0, 0.05/0.0, holding-only 0.10, holding-only 0.30, 0/0.05), so no result may be reused and a fresh complete backend run using the Task initializer and warm-start policy is required; all five records stay references only. Fixed science: robot, task, acceptance, evaluate.reach@1.0.0, model.serial_bending_cells, controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0, timing (control period 0.01 s F1656, duration 0.35 s), solver budget (max_iterations 120, max_cpu_s 30), horizon 10 and initialization/warm-start policy; no local solve, no saved-state replay, no paid query, no new diagnostic. Evidence: predecessor summary (terminal error 0.008186891107577365 m F1017 with terminal_reach_passed true F971 and official success F1018; holding max error 0.008275123365557732 m F997/F1631; holding_speed_passed false F1068; validity valid F1001; initialization_selected 17 F1649; deadline_misses 35 F972; mean complete update 16.876452619954943 s F926; simulation wall 592.5 s F963); sealed comparisons (predecessor-minus-baseline terminal +0.0005442825217099791 m F947 and holding max error -0.049862980920174826 m F969, classification physical_tradeoff F1066, candidate joint_reach_holding_passed false F1041, baseline F1032, baseline holding max speed 1.5810152739742807 m/s F1043/F943; older 0.05/0.0 candidate holding max speed 1.1750052670100422 m/s F1742, baseline holding max error 0.05813810428573256 m F1047/F1069, deadline_misses 35 both F1054/F1063); and the performed plans-view check result (artifact 0013c7bd..., one tool, update_ids 0,8,16,24,28,30,32,34) with aliases F170, F147, F151, F172, F178, F168, F145, F146, F177, F1724/F1072, F1682, F527 showing compute-budget termination and late horizon truncation as controller-side plan records. Those records and the sealed arithmetic are not causal evidence; no dominant cause is established and this submission claims no physical improvement and no range-level effect. Budget: the predecessor's advisory 1200 s allocation is rejected as a total workflow cap (990 s per backend attempt = 900 simulation + 30 evaluation F526 + 60 profile F547, plus >=600 s interpretation and planning/recovery/delivery); planned_budget declares the full separate Stage 3.59 grant (8 model, 20 tool, 4200 s, backend_solves = max_backend_attempts = 1, workers 0), satisfying model_calls >= 5, tool_calls >= 4*1+7 = 11, wall_s >= 990*1+600 = 1590, backend_solves = max_backend_attempts and worker_calls = 0; the proposal cap is 4 (F529) and only one proposal is used. Recommendation acceptance (F488 retain_baseline, both diagnostic deferrals) is kept separate from controller-candidate selection: no candidate is selected as an overall improvement here.
stopping_conditions: Stop normally when target_changed_configurations = 1 distinct changed configuration (terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.10, holding fixed 0.0) has a complete simulation, sealed evaluation and profile, or when the single explicit proposal is consumed.
Stop on material failure: solver error count > 0, invalid or incomplete execution, backend error, or a candidate that cannot be prepared and validated; do not substitute another point mid-run.

No mid-run early reach test exists: joint acceptance is assessed only after the complete evaluation and profile, so a terminal-reach failure observed afterwards ends the batch normally and only describes the tested 0.10 point.

Stop if remaining delivery capacity falls below the reservations (>= 990 s per backend attempt plus >= 600 s interpretation, with planning/recovery/model/tool slots) needed to deliver a complete result.
weakening_observations: Movement is not acceptance: the immediate predecessor raised terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.05 and lowered sampled holding max speed from 1.5810152739742807 m/s (F1043, F943) to 0.03556730769134125 m/s, yet holding_speed_passed stays false (F1068) and joint_reach_holding_passed stays false for candidate and baseline (F1041, F1032) with classification physical_tradeoff (F1066); a further reduction at 0.10 need not reach 0.02 m/s.

Higher tip-speed cost weights elsewhere on this stack lost terminal reach: the holding-only 0.10 point recorded terminal_error_m 0.011558241033380132 m and the 0.30 point 0.018690324120991027 m with terminal_reach_passed false, so the 0.10 terminal point may equally trade reach away; the predecessor's reach margin is thin (terminal 0.008186891107577365 m, F1017, versus tolerance 0.01 m).

Compute budget is unchanged by the compared weight changes: deadline_misses 35 of 35 updates in both runs of the sealed comparison (F1054, F1063) and 35 in the predecessor profile (F972), User_Requested_Stop 34 (F1724, F1072), and the performed plans-view check records effective_horizon 10 at update 0 (F170) truncated to 5 at update 30 (F147) with update_wall_s 17.096778000006452 s at update 28 (F151) against control_period_s 0.01 (F1656); a weight-only change is not evidenced to alter these.

Frames and coverage limit inference: sampled hold evidence is 6 final-window samples only (F1682) with no continuous-time guarantee, world tip vectors are reconstructed (F1656-class definitions), and one-step position predictions do not certify holding-window tip speed (F527); the checked plan records F147/F151/F172/F178/F168/F145/F146/F177 are controller-side values, not backend motion.
